description: Wave Folder amplifies a signal and folds it back at 5V either way through a fixed number of stages, with every amplifier under voltage control

params.text: Sets the maximum number of folding stages, 2 to 6 with a default of 3, which caps how many folds heavy amplification can produce
Sets oversampling against the aliasing folding and modulation introduce: off, x2, x4 by default, x8, x16 or x32, and it is applied to every input
Sets the amplification applied to the input before any folding, 0 to 10 with unity at 1; more amplification gives more folds
Sets the amplification applied inside each folding stage, 0.5 to 10 on an exponential scale that spreads out the useful values between 1 and 2
Adds -5V to 5V to the input before any amplification, which makes the folding asymmetric
Attenuates or inverts the pre-amp CV before it is summed with the Pre-amp knob, -100% to 100%
Attenuates or inverts the stage amp CV before it is summed with the Stage amp knob, -100% to 100%
Attenuates or inverts the bias CV before it is summed with the Bias knob, -100% to 100%

inputs.text: Voltage control of the pre-amp; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total is unconstrained. Audio rate CV works
Voltage control of the stage amplification; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total is unconstrained. Audio rate CV works
Voltage control of the bias; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total is unconstrained. Audio rate CV works
The signal to be folded, always oversampled at the rate the OVER SAMPLE button selects

outputs.text: The folded signal, soft clipped at 6V either way by tanh saturation

menu: Disable oversampling, in a CV input's own port menu — leaves that one input unoversampled, which saves CPU on slow modulation; the light beside the port turns red while it is off
Bipolar VCA (ring mod), in the pre-amp or stage amp CV input's own port menu — passes negative amplification and inverts the signal; a yellow light beside the port shows it
Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
